rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This Project Coordinator MCP server by Pineapple provides AI agents with comprehensive Xcode and Swift project management capabilities, combining traditional project tracking with advanced analytics and security validation. Built with Swift and designed for macOS development workflows, it offers project lifecycle management including status tracking, task management, and technology stack detection, while providing analytics features like activity heat maps, technology trend analysis, project health scoring, and status duration tracking. The implementation includes robust security validation with configurable path restrictions, input sanitization, and injection attack prevention, plus maintains a knowledge base of Swift patterns, SwiftUI best practices, and Xcode troubleshooting guides, making it valuable for iOS/macOS developers who want AI-assisted project coordination with built-in security and comprehensive project insights.
